mission: Learn transferable party development for story completion and a retained living Pokedex, with Red as the first curriculum and later titles as adaptation tests.

new_semantics: global registration, living-collection and role-coverage progress
party-wide level, evolution, collection, role, health, exhaustion and faint pressure
candidate evolution stages, next-level distance, route mechanism and immediate feasibility
candidate registration need, living-target need and living-retention risk
candidate role need, completed role and emergency-escort need
prospectively frozen venue reliability, expected yield, matchup safety, travel cost, recovery cost and evidence support

priorities: avoid regression in registration, living retention, role coverage, evolution work and level balance
advance the declared primary completion goal
then compare completion gains, evolution, experience efficiency, Center efficiency, faints and frames

learner.initialization: exact score-preserving embedding of the frozen v1 teacher-derived candidate ranker
learner.update: prior-anchored deterministic MLP adaptation with soft listwise targets

initial_fit_gate.purpose: Minimum diversity for a descriptive first Red outcome fit; this is not the authority-promotion gate.

supported: the code can represent completion-aware trainee and venue decisions without execution identity
the historical v1 scorer can initialize the wider model without changing any initial v1 score
measured multi-candidate outcomes, including partial ties, can update the wider model while preserving partition and provenance guards
a path-free catalog audit can stop a semantically thin campaign before fitting
not_supported: a live v2 party-development outcome catalog exists
the party-development outcome model has been fit
the model improves on untouched Red development contexts
the agent can complete Red autonomously
the representation transfers to Crystal or another title
the agent can complete or retain a living Pokedex

next: bind the exact historical v1 model and its two training roots as the initialization prior
inventory non-sealed Red checkpoints semantically without executing a candidate
freeze independent train and development contexts that meet the v2 diversity gate instead of consuming near-duplicate Cinnabar roots
have Claude and Antigravity attack the representation, objective and data gate before any new live candidate execution
publish an exact-source prospective collection plan and require green CI before controller input
